It’s a practice tool for counselors. It’s not for clients, and it can’t help in a crisis. If you’re going through a hard time yourself, tap “Need help?” below.

We don’t send your email or account ID, and our servers don’t store the conversation. Nothing is sent unless you agree below.

Each message, with the conversation so far, goes to our server and on to %1$s, a third-party AI service run by Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd. in China, which writes the reply. We don’t send your email or account ID.
Our servers don’t store the conversation or log its text.
Does the AI model service store it?
It handles the conversation under its own privacy policy, which says data is stored in China. That’s one more reason not to enter real client information.
Is it stored on my phone?

Yes. Each session and its report are saved, unencrypted, in the app’s own space on this phone. Nothing is uploaded or backed up to the cloud. Turn saving off or delete everything under Me; delete a single session from your practice history. Uninstalling the app deletes everything.

Your email (to sign in), your sign-up date, the invite batch you signed up with, and your sessions. Your interface language is sent with each request. We don’t collect your name, phone number or location.

On our server we count numbers per day, split by case and interface language: sessions started, sessions the client ended, reports written, turns per session, how long a session lasts, errors, and 👍/👎 ratings and reports. Active users are counted with pseudonyms that change every day and every week, never with your email, and the details are summed up and deleted soon after. No conversation.
Can I enter real client information?
No. Please use it for practice only.

How do I delete my account?

Go to Me → Delete account. We delete your account data from our server right away, and this account’s practice history on this phone too. If you can’t use the app, follow the steps at psygym.novawerk.io/delete-account.
